_doc: Real-time travel. Trip minutes = minutesAtRef * (lightYears / refLy) ^ exponent: Alpha Centauri about 45 minutes, 12 ly about 10 hours, a beacon (25-43 ly) about 3 to 10 days. Since 2026-11-14 (docs/plan-daily-life.md, the universe) a ship runs on starlight, not Ember: see power and routes. needCopy: someone has to stay behind, so you can only launch from a planet that has at least one copy (off since 2026-10-28: every copy now needs a Nous Chip, so most worlds have no copy to leave). ?fast in the URL turns minutes into seconds for testing. inSystemMinutes: real-time length of a hop between two planets of the same star. fixedSeconds: when above 0, every trip takes exactly that many seconds (Steve asked for 5 s trips on 2026-10-06); set it to 0 to bring back real-time travel. cruise (below) is used when fixedSeconds is 0.

cruise._doc: A trip takes secondsPerLy for every light year (Steve, 2026-10-27: 2 seconds a light year, after 0.1 and 15 on 2026-10-25; from the homeworld the nearest star, TRAPPIST-1, about 44 s, Gliese 12 about 49 s, Earth about 1 min 38 s, the farthest catalog star about 4 min); a hop between planets of the same star takes inSystemSeconds. Used while enabled; set enabled false (and fixedSeconds 0) for real-time travel, or fixedSeconds above 0 for a fixed trip.

starLight._doc: Light color of each spectral class (first letter), mixed into a world's darkness color and sky.

power._doc: A ship's cells (Steve, 2026-11-14: ships run on starlight; Ember is only for Vessels). cells: what a full ship holds. Parked on a world, the cells charge from its star by the clock, also while nobody plays: chargePerHour by spectral class (first letter; a red dwarf slowly, a bright star fast). A trip costs base + perLy for every light year (a fifth on a charted route, routes.costShare). A finished fusion still on the world you board from tops the cells up from the store's hydrogen: hydrogenCharge per hydrogen, never taking the store below keepHydrogen (husks need it). A ship with no cells saved yet starts full.

routes._doc: Charted routes (migration 0017): the first flight between two stars charts the route for the whole Metanoia; a charted route costs costShare of the charge and takes timeShare of the time, and the star map draws it.
